_note: test-plan.md §3's overlap-a / overlap-b, at the record layer rather than the
issue layer. Phase 1 has no extractor, so what it needs from those fixtures is
the pair of records they would produce: one article, two sources, two
different redirectors wrapping the same publisher URL.
The .html issues those names refer to belong to phase 2, which is where an
extractor exists to read them. Keeping the pair here as records is what lets
story-record.md §3 case 2 be tested in the phase that implements it.
